# Independent ADP references

The generator in crysta's `tests/fixtures/anisotropic_adps/generate.py`
runs cctbx-base 2026.8 (`sgtbx`, `uctbx`, `adptbx`) and the
unmodified CrySPY `A_functions_base/debye_waller_factor.py`. It never imports
crysta or edi. `numeric.json` records the CrySPY source digest. The generator
loads CrySPY's package path without its top-level initialization so that its
unrelated optional engines are not needed.

The space-group table supplies only Hall identities, representative positions
and the row census. For each of its 3,467 rows, cctbx independently finds the
stabilizer at two generic points and supplies a basis of the allowed U-star
subspace. cctbx converts every basis vector into U, B and beta. Compatible
cells come from `any_compatible_unit_cell(volume=1000)`, including noncubic
monoclinic and hexagonal metrics. The tests compare orthogonal projectors,
so they do not prescribe which independent components the engine chooses.

`numeric.json` contains noncubic conversions from cctbx and DW amplitudes
from CrySPY at signed, mixed-index reflections. `dw.tsv` carries the same
values for the native test. The Y2O3 beta values are those in the FullProf
input below; cctbx supplies their U and B equivalents.

`fullprof/` is byte-identical to diffraction-lib's committed
`docs/docs/verification/fullprof/pd-neut-cwl_y2o3_beta-adp/`, obtained from
the local v0.19.1 checkout. `fullprof-sha256.json` identifies every input and
output by content. The profile bound follows the existing Y2O3 isotropic
page's maximum profile difference of 0.01 percent; it is an acceptance
tolerance, not a measured error. No reference is generated by the engine
under test.

Regenerate from the crysta checkout with a cctbx environment:

```sh
python tests/fixtures/anisotropic_adps/generate.py \
  --cryspy-root /path/to/cryspy \
  --fullprof-root /path/to/diffraction-lib/docs/docs/verification/fullprof/pd-neut-cwl_y2o3_beta-adp \
  --mirror /path/to/edi/tests/fixtures/anisotropic_adps
```

The mirror contains the same numeric and FullProf references for the edi
consumer gates. The full subspace census is tested in the engine's native
integration tier. GUI appearance remains subject to the owner's look check
while the app tiers are disabled.
